posts.headline: Walmart Beats Q4 Revenue but Issues Cautious 2026 Guidance
posts.body: Walmart narrowly exceeded Wall Street expectations for the fourth quarter, reporting strong holiday sales performance. However, the retail giant issued conservative guidance for fiscal 2026, citing substantial macroeconomic uncertainty. The company announced a $30 billion share buyback program while projecting adjusted EPS of $2.75 to $2.85, below analyst forecasts of $2.96.

posts.headline: Dropbox Shares Fall 4% Despite Earnings Beat on Weak 2026 Guidance
posts.body: Dropbox reported better-than-expected fourth-quarter results but saw its stock decline over 4% in premarket trading. The cloud storage company's fiscal 2026 sales guidance failed to impress analysts, overshadowing the earnings beat.

posts.headline: Big Tech Plans $650B AI Infrastructure Spend in 2026
posts.body: Bloomberg reports that Google parent Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft plan to invest roughly $650 billion this year in data centers, chips, and infrastructure as the AI race accelerates.

posts.headline: US Core PCE YoY Actual 3.0% vs Forecast 2.9% - Hotter Than Expected
posts.body: US Core PCE Price Index came in at 3.0% YoY (Forecast 2.9%, Previous 2.8%). The hotter-than-expected inflation reading could impact Fed rate cut expectations for 2026.
